svg.title: decision-agent-flow
svg.desc: Decision Support Agent hosted in Foundry accepts registered evidence, calibrated Azure ML crop rating and approved deterministic rules. AKS registers action provenance before routing to officials, a focused farmer request or a proposed inspection requiring authorised approval. Independent probability sampling is separate; findings are locked before AI reveal. Models never own entitlement or payment authority.

text.tspan: Decision Support Agent · evidence to action
Foundry hosts the agent; AKS owns typed tools and authoritative case updates
Typed APIs; no direct DB writes
Consistent cases too; photos cannot replace
D4 · scoped response / evidence → registered receipt → reassessment
D5 · independent selection → authorised task; findings also feed separate quality reporting
UNKNOWN is not non-compliance; contested outcomes go to officials.
Request: affected parcel / issue, rule, response deadline and next action.
No response / late evidence: reassess available facts under approved rules.
Track affected scope / amount; never infer a whole-claim adverse result.
Correlate: case / parcel / evidence / assessment / ML job / tool IDs.
Telemetry: minimised metadata only; no raw claimant material.
Proposed deployment · P proposed process / service; dashed sample route is independent · D1–D5 authority safeguards · author r4
